controls.name: rebuild-swaps
controls.find: pub open spec fn swaps() -> bool { false }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn swaps() -> bool { true }
controls.classification: decision: BuildKG builds the index aside and swaps it in once (the repair); no reader sees the purged index

controls.name: refill-keeps-old
controls.find: if swaps() { if k < rows.len() { old } else { rows } } else { rows.subrange(0, k) }
controls.replace: if swaps() { if k < rows.len() { old } else { rows } } else { if k == 0 { old } else { rows.subrange(0, k) } }
controls.classification: effect: the purge is not visible before the first refill step (the index is emptied only together with its first new entry)

controls.name: refill-invents
controls.find: if swaps() { if k < rows.len() { old } else { rows } } else { rows.subrange(0, k) }
controls.replace: if swaps() { if k < rows.len() { old } else { rows } } else { old + rows.subrange(0, k) }
controls.classification: effect: the purge is skipped, so entries with no row behind them stay visible during and after the rebuild

controls.name: swap-exposes-prefix
controls.find: pub open spec fn visible_swap(old: Seq<Edge>, rows: Seq<Edge>, k: int) -> Seq<Edge> { if k < rows.len() { old } else { rows } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn visible_swap(old: Seq<Edge>, rows: Seq<Edge>, k: int) -> Seq<Edge> { rows.subrange(0, k) }
controls.classification: repair weakened: the swapping rebuild exposes its partial build
